architect.rationale: TierStatus is the correct first delta for P13-tenancy — TenantTier and TenantStatus are the primitives every downstream use-case (SuspendTenantUseCase, ReinstateUseCase, EnableProductUseCase) depends on. SuspensionReason carries the typed audit reason required by ADR-0018. Module placement in oya-tenancy-kernel::tier_status matches the pattern established by P07 (severity.rs) and P04 (merkle_tree.rs).
